### GET `/api/OpenOrders/GetIdentifiers`

Get all identifiers that are available to add to an order

### POST `/api/OpenOrders/GetIdentifiersByOrderIds`

Get all identifiers for a list of orderIds

### POST `/api/OpenOrders/SaveIdentifier`

Create or update an order identifier

### POST `/api/OpenOrders/DeleteIdentifier`

Delete an identifier. This will also remove the identifier from all orders that it's assigned to

### POST `/api/OpenOrders/AssignOrderIdentifier`

Add an identifier to an order

### POST `/api/OpenOrders/UnassignOrderIdentifier`

Remove an identifier from an order

### POST `/api/OpenOrders/GetOrdersLowFidelity`

Returns low fidelity view of open orders. The data is generally useful for very basic view or counters of what is in the open orders. Useful for finding orders quickly as it returns all scannable fields of the order and order items such as order ids, skus, barcodes etc. Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.OrderBook.DespatchConsoleNode

### POST `/api/OpenOrders/GetOpenOrdersDetails`

Open order details by order ids. Not limited by the number of orders you can retrieve. This call is designed to return ONLY open orders, it is much faster than GetOrderDetail call Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.OrderBook.ViewOrderDetailsNode

### POST `/api/OpenOrders/AssignStockToOrders`

Assign Stock to Orders Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.OrderBook.OpenOrdersNode
